VarMem.value: 'SELECT DISTINCT GRGR.GRGR_ID,SBSB.SBSB_ID,MEMD.MEME_HICN AS HICN,MEME.MEME_ORIG_EFF_DT, MEPE.CSCS_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND,MEPE.MEPE_CREATE_DTM, MEMD.MEMD_MCTR_PBP,MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT,MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT, MMR.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR,MMR.COV_START_DT,MMR.COV_END_DT,MMR.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID  FROM  CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR JOIN CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB  ON SBSB.GRGR_CK=GRGR.GRGR_CK JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK=SBSB.SBSB_CK  AND MEME.GRGR_CK=SBSB.GRGR_CK JOIN CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK=MEME.MEME_CK  AND MEPE.GRGR_CK=MEME.GRGR_CK  JOIN CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL MEMD ON MEMD.MEME_CK=MEME.MEME_CK AND MEMD.MEMD_EVENT_CD in ('PBP') AND (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT>=MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT and MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT <=MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT) and MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT>=MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT   JOIN AGP.MMR_HICN_LOAD MMR ON MMR.MEME_CK = MEMD.MEME_CK    AND MMR.COV_START_DT BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT   AND MMR.COV_END_DT BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT  AND MMR.COV_START_DT BETWEEN MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT AND MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT   AND MMR.COV_END_DT BETWEEN MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT AND MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT  WHERE   MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'N'  AND GRGR.GRGR_MCTR_TYPE='MDCR' and MEMD.MEMD_MCTR_PBP IS NOT NULL AND trunc(MMR.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID) =MEMD.MEMD_MCTR_PBP   UNION SELECT DISTINCT GRGR.GRGR_ID,SBSB.SBSB_ID,MEMD.MEME_HICN AS HICN,MEME.MEME_ORIG_EFF_DT, MEPE.CSCS_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND,MEPE.MEPE_CREATE_DTM,MMR.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID, MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT,MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT, MMR.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR,MMR.COV_START_DT,MMR.COV_END_DT,MMR.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID  FROM  CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR JOIN CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB  ON SBSB.GRGR_CK=GRGR.GRGR_CK  AND GRGR.GRGR_MCTR_TYPE='MDCR'  JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK=SBSB.SBSB_CK  AND MEME.GRGR_CK=SBSB.GRGR_CK  JOIN CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK=MEME.MEME_CK  AND MEPE.GRGR_CK=MEME.GRGR_CK LEFT JOIN CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL MEMD ON MEMD.MEME_CK=MEME.MEME_CK AND MEMD.MEMD_EVENT_CD in ('HICN') AND /*(MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT>=MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT and MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT <=MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT) and*/ MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT>=MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT  JOIN AGP.MMR_HICN_LOAD MMR  ON MMR.MEME_CK = MEMD.MEME_CK     WHERE    MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'N'  AND MMR.COV_START_DT BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT   AND MMR.COV_END_DT BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT  AND MMR.COV_START_DT BETWEEN MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT AND MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT   AND MMR.COV_END_DT BETWEEN MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT AND MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT  AND MMR.GRGR_CK=MEME.GRGR_CK    AND MMR.CMS_MBR_HIC_NBR_ID FROM PSGL.CMS_MMR_INITIAL_LOAD
WHERE [CMS_CNTRCT_NBR] NOT IN (
		SELECT DISTINCT CMS_CNTRCT_NBR
		FROM FINANCE.MMR_CTRCT_GRCK
		)

DELETE 
FROM [PSGL].[CMS_MMR_INITIAL_LOAD] 
WHERE [ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT] < '2015/01/01'

DELETE  
FROM PSGL.CMS_MMR_INITIAL_LOAD 
WHERE (
		CMS_CNTRCT_NBR = 'H3447'
		AND (				
					(
				ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT < CAST('01/01/2019' AS DATETIME)
				AND CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID IN ('001', '003', '004', '005', '010', '026')
				)
			)
		)
	OR (
		CMS_CNTRCT_NBR = 'H0544'
		AND (
				(ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT < CAST('01/01/2019' AS DATETIME) AND 
				CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID IN ('002', '003', '004', '005', '007', '008', '010', '012', '013', '014', '015', '019', '020', '021', '024', '025', '027', '028', '031', '032', '036', '037', '038', '041', '043', '049', '050', '802')							 
				)	
			OR
				(ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT < CAST('01/01/2018' AS DATETIME) 				 
				)						
			)
		)
	OR (
		CMS_CNTRCT_NBR = 'H8432'
		AND (
			(
				CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID > '799'
				AND ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT < CAST('01/01/2019' AS DATETIME)
				)
			)
		)
	OR (
		CMS_CNTRCT_NBR = 'H4346'
		AND (
			(
				CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID BETWEEN '001' AND '011'
				AND ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT < CAST('01/01/2019' AS DATETIME)
				)
			OR (
				CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID BETWEEN '012' AND '014'
				AND ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT < CAST('01/01/2018' AS DATETIME)
				)
			)
		)
	OR (
		CMS_CNTRCT_NBR = 'H7728'
		AND CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID > '799'
		AND ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT < CAST('01/01/2019' AS DATETIME)
		)
	OR (
		CMS_CNTRCT_NBR IN ('H5471', 'H6229')
		AND ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT < CAST('01/01/2019' AS DATETIME)
		)
	OR (
		CMS_CNTRCT_NBR IN ('H5471', 'H6229')
		AND CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID > '799'
		)
                      OR (
		CMS_CNTRCT_NBR IN ('H1947', 'H9065')
		AND 
			(ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT < CAST('01/01/2020' AS DATETIME) OR
				CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID > '799'
			)
		) 
		OR (
		CMS_CNTRCT_NBR = 'H4036'
		AND CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID > '799'
		AND ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT < CAST('01/01/2020' AS DATETIME)
		)
